reports.text: Current public Polymarket pages showed rounded odds near 4% for a Taiwan invasion, 8% for a China-Taiwan clash, 8% for NATO Article 5 and 10% for a 2026 Ukraine peace deal. Differing definitions and horizons make these sanity checks only.

reports.headline: Haiti asks UN to renew international anti-gang force
reports.text: Haiti’s government asked the Security Council to renew the international anti-gang force before its mandate expires. The request is a capacity and continuity watch item, not a new attack or configured signal transition; Haiti holds 30/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: IAEA chief says Iran retains many capabilities as inspections remain blocked
reports.text: Scripps News reports the IAEA Director General warned that Iran retains much of the programme’s capacity while Iranian officials continue to block IAEA inspections. This reconfirms the access-denial indicator; no other configured technical threshold was verified. Iran nuclear holds 75 raw / 82 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Spain says Morocco allowed crossings but rejects claim Rabat designed Ceuta surge
reports.text: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said Moroccan gendarmes allowed crossings during the peak July surge but said no evidence showed Rabat designed or executed the crisis. Spain promised further investigation. The update sharpens attribution but does not meet a configured escalation threshold; Ceuta/Melilla holds 27/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: High-tempo Russia-Ukraine drone operations continue across rear-area targets
reports.text: Fresh indexed reporting and OilPrice coverage describe continued Russian missile/drone pressure and a Ukrainian drone barrage that set a Russian oil port ablaze. This reconfirms the active canonical military_buildup context but does not create a separate threshold. Russia-Ukraine holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Iran diplomatic indicator expires after configured evidence window
reports.text: The earlier diplomatic-channel evidence aged out during mandatory deployment. Controlled but restricted Hormuz throughput remains the only active configured Iran-conventional indicator; probability holds at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Hormuz traffic estimates diverge while passage remains restricted
reports.text: Al Jazeera and current energy coverage report sharply divergent traffic counts through the Strait. Available evidence supports controlled and restricted passage, not verified full closure or zero traffic; no probability increment is applied.

reports.headline: U.S.–Iran tit-for-tat strikes continue while Hormuz traffic stays restricted
reports.text: Current reporting says roughly 100 U.S. strikes followed renewed maritime threats and Iran again targeted U.S.-used facilities across Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan and Kuwait. Kpler-linked reporting showed sharply reduced but nonzero Strait traffic. Existing truce-breach, hormuz_mining and hormuz_controlled_not_closed indicators are reconfirmed; risk remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Putin floats a chance for peace as NATO warns Russia is increasingly reckless
reports.text: CNBC reports that Vladimir Putin said there was a chance for peace but insisted Russia and Ukraine must resolve the conflict themselves. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte separately cited missiles and drones crossing Europe’s eastern flank and an alleged Russian hybrid attack at Leipzig airport. No formal negotiating round, fresh nuclear declaration, Article 4/5 action or newly attributed attack on alliance territory was verified; russia_ukraine holds 99/IMMINENT and russia holds 80/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: United States says Israel-Lebanon talks remain positive despite recent setback
reports.text: The Times of Israel reports the U.S. State Department said Israel-Lebanon talks are moving in a positive direction and credited the trilateral military deconfliction cell with containing last week’s escalation within 24 hours. The report reconfirms israel_lebanon:diplomacy_active, while unresolved core objections keep diplomacy_refused active; no fresh hostilities in the current scan justify reactivating ceasefire_violation. Risk holds 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Houthi offensive breaks Yemen truce across Taiz and Red Sea fronts
reports.text: Al Jazeera/AFP and Maritime Executive report fierce clashes, attempted Houthi advances toward the Taiz–Mocha road, ballistic-missile and drone attacks, and fatalities on both sides. The evidence activates ceasefire_violation; Yemen/Red Sea remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Fresh Myanmar airstrikes reported in Karenni and Rakhine areas
reports.text: Myanmar Now reports a junta airstrike killed at least six in the Mawchi mining region; separate Narinjara reporting describes new bombardment across three townships. The renewed infrastructure_strike evidence reactivates the configured indicator and raises Myanmar from 30 to 35/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: U.S. strikes IRGC positions near Hormuz after reported mine-laying attempt
reports.text: The Jerusalem Post, citing an ISW assessment and U.S. reporting, says U.S. forces struck IRGC positions near the Strait after Iran attempted Hormuz mining. The reported mine-laying and fresh strike broke the truce, while vessel reporting still indicates restricted passage rather than verified closure or zero traffic. Iran conventional remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.
sources: Institute for the Study of War

reports.headline: IAEA sees vehicle traffic at Isfahan but still cannot account for enriched uranium
reports.text: IAEA-attributed reporting says regular vehicle traffic was observed near the Isfahan tunnel complex, while inspectors remain unable to verify the location or composition of Iran’s enriched-uranium stockpile or exclude diversion. This reconfirms iaea_access_denied only; Iran nuclear holds 75 raw / 82 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Libya reports attempted drone attack on Tripoli fuel depot without supply disruption
reports.text: Reuters and syndicated reporting cite Libya’s National Oil Corporation saying a remotely controlled drone targeted a Tripoli fuel depot. No casualties or supply interruption were reported, and the indexed account said there was no damage. The attempt is a watch item, but without verified infrastructure damage it does not activate infrastructure_strike; Libya holds 30/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Iran oil-infrastructure-threat indicator expires after evidence window
reports.text: iran_conventional:oil_infrastructure_threat expired during mandatory deployment under its configured evidence window. Diplomacy and controlled-but-restricted Hormuz throughput remain active; probability holds at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Southern Thailand diplomacy indicator expires after evidence window
reports.text: southern_thailand:diplomacy_active expired during mandatory deployment without a fresh formal negotiating round. No fresh qualifying attack or force package was verified; probability holds at 29/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: UN chief condemns renewed U.S.-Iran escalation and urges return to diplomacy
reports.text: UN News reports that U.S. and Iranian forces exchanged renewed strikes and that Secretary-General António Guterres condemned attacks on civilians and urged both sides to return to diplomacy. This reconfirms the active diplomatic channel but does not change the capped Iran-conventional assessment of 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: UN reports at least 12 civilians killed in latest Russian attacks across Ukraine
reports.text: UN News, citing OCHA, says Russian attacks from Tuesday into Wednesday killed at least 12 civilians and injured more than 65 across six regions, damaging homes, schools, energy sites and humanitarian facilities. The sustained nationwide strike pattern reconfirms russia_ukraine:military_buildup; probability remains capped at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: UN probe documents foreign personnel, arms and drone networks fuelling Sudan war
reports.text: The UN fact-finding mission found external support networks are strengthening both belligerents, including foreign recruitment, weapons, logistics and drone support and up to 2,000 former Colombian military contractors alongside RSF units. external_backing activates while infrastructure_strike remains active; Sudan moves 99→100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Iran strike-cycle indicator expires after evidence window
reports.text: The prior short-window strike-cycle indicator expired during mandatory deployment under its evidence-decay rules. Diplomacy, controlled-but-restricted Hormuz throughput and oil-infrastructure risk remain active; Iran conventional stays capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Tigray clash indicator expires after evidence window
reports.text: The previously active clash evidence expired during mandatory deployment under the configured 72-hour window. Allied calls to implement the Pretoria framework and renewed African Union mediation remain watch items; no fresh force mobilization or peace-framework breakdown was verified. Ethiopia-Tigray risk holds 36/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Two seafarers killed in renewed oil-tanker attack near Hormuz
reports.text: ABS-CBN and The Business Standard report two Filipino crew members were killed after tankers carrying Saudi oil were attacked near the Strait of Hormuz. The attacker and weapon were not independently established in the retrieved reporting, so this corroborates the maritime threat environment but does not add another configured signal or probability increment.

reports.headline: Finland runs Europe’s largest civil-defence exercise since WWII
reports.text: The Washington Post reports Finland ran Europe’s largest civil-defence exercise since World War II amid concern over cyberattack, sabotage and wider Russian hybrid threats. The defensive-preparedness measure reinforces allied vigilance but does not establish an attributed attack on NATO territory, Article 4/5 action or alliance combat deployment; Russia-NATO risk holds 80/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Pakistan says troops killed 15 militants infiltrating from Afghanistan
reports.text: Pakistan’s ISPR says troops killed 15 militants during a 36-hour engagement after an attempted infiltration through North Waziristan from Afghanistan. Arab News Pakistan and The Express Tribune report the same military claim. This is a serious border-security event, but the scan did not establish state-on-state action or a distinct new operational force package; Pakistan-Afghanistan risk holds 43/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Taiwan protests Chinese combat-readiness patrol near Minzhu Reef
reports.text: Taiwan’s Foreign Ministry and Taiwan News report a Chinese combat-readiness patrol around Minzhu Reef after joint military and coast-guard drills, and allege dangerous maneuvering near a Taiwanese surveillance aircraft. The disclosed facts do not establish a distinct new force package, weapons release, collision or blockade; South China Sea risk holds 40/CRITICAL with no configured signal transition.

reports.headline: Israel-Lebanon indicator expires after configured evidence window
reports.text: israel_lebanon:ceasefire_violation decayed to inactive during deployment. No probability change is applied; the tracker remains 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Yemen-Red Sea indicator expires after configured evidence window
reports.text: yemen_red_sea:infrastructure_strike decayed to inactive during deployment. No probability change is applied; the tracker remains 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Hormuz throughput rebuts total-closure classification
reports.text: About 40 vessels carrying millions of barrels transited on 1 September, and more than 17 million barrels moved on 31 August. Hormuz restricted traffic and continuing tanker attacks support coercive-control status, not total closure. Signal changed: hormuz_closed inactive; hormuz_controlled_not_closed active. Iran conventional risk remains capped at 100.

reports.headline: Iran rebuilds degraded maritime-control capability after U.S. strikes
reports.text: ISW/CTP says Iran is attempting to restore radar, maritime and mine-laying capacity while U.S. forces guide shipping through the Strait. Reporting also flags possible Iranian interest in undersea-cable sabotage, but technical capability and an attack order are unverified; no additional signal is activated.

reports.headline: Reported Iranian effort to preserve covert Iraqi militia capacity
reports.text: Public context unavailable; consult the original source.

reports.headline: Hezbollah-linked Assadist training claim stays below Syria trigger
reports.text: Lebanese arrests and source reporting cited by ISW/CTP indicate a network trained for drone and IED activity aimed at Syria. The activity concerns coastal Syria and does not establish a fresh Idlib strike or verified deployment; syria_idlib:external_backing remains inactive.

reports.headline: Kuwait says air defenses are confronting a new Iranian missile and drone attack
reports.text: Kuwait's armed forces said air defenses were intercepting hostile Iranian missile and drone attacks and that explosion sounds were caused by interceptions. Iranian state media claimed a U.S. base was hit, but neither Kuwait nor the United States confirmed that claim. The previously confirmed 2 September residential-complex drone impact keeps infrastructure_strike active; no additional canonical signal or probability increase is applied, so kuwait_iraq_border holds 35/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Russia indicator expires after configured evidence window
reports.text: The older State Duma tactical-nuclear advocacy aged below the configured temporal evidence floor without a fresh executive or official renewal. Russia eases 72→70 raw and 82→80 coupled, remaining IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Kuwait confirms drone impact during Iranian attacks on U.S.-linked sites
reports.text: Reuters reports Iran said it attacked the U.S. Ali Al Salem air base and a nearby residential compound in Kuwait. Kuwait's fire service confirmed it extinguished a blaze at a residential complex hit by a drone. The confirmed impact qualifies as an infrastructure strike for the Kuwait-Iraq regional-spillover tracker, raising it 30→35/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Israeli defence minister says Gaza removal plan remains under discussion
reports.text: Israel's defence minister told a Ynet conference that removing Palestinians from Gaza remains the preferred eventual outcome and described the plan as frozen rather than cancelled. The statement materially worsens the policy-risk backdrop but does not establish a new configured threshold; Israel-Palestine holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Trump aides reportedly seek a quieter Iran campaign before November elections
reports.text: Reuters reports, citing administration sources, that U.S. aides want to keep the Iran campaign comparatively quiet before the November elections while leaving open more intense attacks afterward. No implemented operational pause was announced; Iran conventional remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Taiwan report says PLA exercises increasingly emphasize blockade scenarios
reports.text: A Taiwanese defence-ministry report says recent PLA exercises increasingly focus on blockade, quarantine and joint landing scenarios, while assessing that China still lacks the capacity for a full-scale landing assault. The report heightens the blockade watch but shows no fresh operational force package; China holds 24 raw / 29 coupled, CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Saudi Arabia says Iran attacked Bahri tanker in Hormuz, killing two crew
reports.text: Saudi Arabia accused Iran of attacking the Bahri-owned Sidr tanker in the Strait of Hormuz on 31 August. Bahri confirmed a security incident; reporting says two Filipino crew members were killed. Iran separately said two tankers struck mines, while the precise attack mechanism remains disputed. Existing shipping-restriction and hostilities indicators are reconfirmed; Iran conventional stays capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: TWO SAILORS KILLED ON SAUDI SUPERTANKER; RIYADH ATTRIBUTES ATTACK TO IRAN
reports.text: Saudi Arabia said the Bahri tanker Sidr was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and two Filipino crew members were killed; Bahri confirmed a security incident. Iran disputed the account and alleged the vessels struck mines. Decision: reconfirm hormuz_closed and ceasefire_violation; Iran conventional risk remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: WFP AID CONVOY HIT IN SOUTH KORDOFAN; TWO MARKED TRUCKS DESTROYED
reports.text: WFP said an air strike outside Dilling on 30 August destroyed two clearly marked aid trucks carrying more than 50 tonnes of food—one month of assistance for about 5,800 people. No casualties or perpetrator attribution were established in the reviewed reports. Decision: activate sudan:infrastructure_strike; raise Sudan 94→99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Spanish police report alleges Moroccan direction of July Ceuta crossings
reports.text: A Spanish police intelligence report submitted to the National Court alleges Moroccan security personnel directed waves of migrants during the 30-31 July Ceuta crossings. Spain's government said it had not received the report and urged caution, so Moroccan state involvement remains disputed. No new configured threshold is applied; risk holds 27/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: EU and member states summon Russian officials over Leipzig drone case
reports.text: Reuters reports that the EU diplomatic service, France, the Netherlands and Belgium summoned Russian officials after Germany attributed the Leipzig/Halle explosives-drone attempt to Russia. France urged EU-level sanctions and Moscow promised a response. No NATO treaty action or new configured threshold was reported; Russia holds 72 raw / 82 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: EU STATES SUMMON RUSSIAN DIPLOMATS OVER LEIPZIG DRONE ATTACK
reports.text: Germany attributed the August explosives-drone attempt at Leipzig/Halle Airport to Russia; the EU and several member states summoned Russian officials, and France advocated further sanctions. Russia denied the evidence. Decision: no new canonical Russia signal or NATO Article 4/5 action; hold 72 raw / 82 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Seventh straight day of Russian attacks brings 174 drones and fresh casualties
reports.text: Associated Press reports that Russia launched 174 attack drones, about half of them jet-powered, plus four missiles overnight; strikes damaged apartment buildings in Odesa and the Kyiv region and wounded at least eight civilians. Russian authorities separately said Ukrainian drones killed two people and wounded 16 in Belgorod. The sustained reciprocal air campaign reconfirms military_buildup, but adds no separate configured transition; russia_ukraine holds 99/IMMINENT.
sources: Ukrainian Air Force and regional authorities (attributed)

reports.headline: Taiwan says planned defence spending will exceed T$1 trillion next year
reports.text: Reuters reported that President Lai Ching-te said Taiwan's planned defence spending for next year will exceed T$1 trillion ($31.47 billion), presenting it as evidence of the island's determination to strengthen its defences. This is defensive budgeting by Taiwan, not evidence of a fresh Chinese operational force package or a configured signal transition. China risk holds 24 raw / 29 coupled, CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Israeli fire kills four in Gaza as military reports capture operation
reports.text: Reuters reported, citing Gaza medics, that Israeli fire killed four people including three children; the Israeli military separately said special forces captured a Hamas official in Gaza City. The casualty report and operation reconfirm ceasefire_violation. The mediator-backed channel remains active, but no implemented settlement was verified; risk holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: IAEA closes Syria file while Iran verification remains stalled
reports.text: Anadolu Agency reports that the IAEA closed Syria’s long-running safeguards issue while Director General Rafael Grossi said verification and monitoring in Iran remain stalled after the war and loss of access. The report reconfirms iaea_access_denied; no evidence met another configured Iranian nuclear threshold. Iran nuclear risk holds 82/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Hezbollah drone attack draws new Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon
reports.text: Israel’s military said Hezbollah launched two explosive-laden drones at troops on the Ali Taher Ridge and that one was intercepted; Israeli forces then struck Hezbollah targets across southern Lebanon. Times of Israel and Ynet carry the military account. The episode broke the truce inside the configured evidence window; Israel-Lebanon remains 99 raw / 100 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Investigation says Russia assisted an Iranian supersonic cruise-missile programme
reports.text: A Financial Times investigation based on leaked correspondence, travel records and patents says Russia’s state arms exporter coordinated technical support for Iran’s C430L ramjet programme. The reporting says Iran built and flight-tested a propulsion system, but found no evidence that a Russian-assisted supersonic cruise missile has been deployed. Iran International and the Jerusalem Post repeated the FT findings rather than independently confirming them. This is a strategic capability watch item, not a configured signal transition; conventional risk stays capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Brent jumps more than 5% as renewed U.S.-Iran attacks hit Hormuz risk premium
reports.text: Trading Economics recorded Brent at $95.33 a barrel on September 1, up 5.34%, and WTI near $90.80 after fresh U.S. strikes around the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on tankers. Bloomberg and CNBC also reported the renewed risk premium. Energy remains a corroborating sanity check rather than a mechanical probability input; the tracker stays capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Mali external-backing signal expires after configured decay
reports.text: The canonical mali_sahel:external_backing signal decayed below the configured evidence floor without fresh qualifying confirmation. The 30 August Algerian fighter deployment remains historical evidence, but it no longer carries active signal weight. Mali / Central Sahel returns 44→40 and remains CRITICAL.
sources: Algerian Ministry of National Defence / Algeria Press Service (30 August source event)

reports.headline: Germany investigates second power-grid sabotage incident; attribution unresolved
reports.text: Reuters reports German police are investigating premeditated vandalism at a substation near Bergheim after separate devices damaged power lines in Brandenburg. Grid stability was maintained, although RWE temporarily removed 4.2 GW of lignite capacity. Berlin separately blamed Russia for an August explosives-drone attempt at Leipzig/Halle Airport, but the new grid incidents have not been attributed. No Article 4/5 action or configured russia signal transition was verified; raw/coupled risk holds 72/82, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Southern Thailand strike signal expires; peace channel remains active
reports.text: The configured 72-hour window for southern_thailand:infrastructure_strike expired without a fresh qualifying attack report. diplomacy_active remains active for the planned late-September BRN round. Southern Thailand falls 34→29 and remains CRITICAL.
sources: Bangkok Post / Thai Examiner / Pattani Police / ISOC Region 4 (30 August source event)

reports.headline: Sudan buildup signal expires after configured decay window
reports.text: The configured 72-hour window for sudan:military_buildup expired. The Yale satellite assessment and 31 August UN briefing remain material conflict evidence, but no fresh qualifying force-buildup report renewed the signal in the scan window. Sudan returns 100→94 and remains IMMINENT.
sources: Yale Humanitarian Research Lab / regional reporting (30 August source event)
United Nations Office of the Spokesperson (31 August corroboration)

reports.headline: Myanmar strike signal expires after configured decay window
reports.text: The configured 72-hour decay window for myanmar:infrastructure_strike expired without a fresh qualifying strike report in the past-24-hour deep scan. The 31 August Shwegu reporting remains historically relevant, but it no longer supports an active signal. Risk returns 35→30 and remains CRITICAL.
sources: Burma News International / Kachin News Group (31 August source event)

reports.headline: Iran says U.S. strike hit Sirik wedding, killing five
reports.text: Reuters and Al Jazeera reported that Iranian authorities said a U.S. strike in Sirik hit a wedding gathering and killed five people, including a child. The casualty claim remains attributed to Iran, but the strike is part of the independently confirmed U.S.-Iran exchange and reconfirms the canonical ceasefire_violation signal. Iran conventional is already capped at 100/IMMINENT, so no numeric increase is applied.

reports.headline: U.S. and Iran complete their largest exchange of strikes in weeks
reports.text: Reuters reported that U.S. Central Command completed a new strike wave against IRGC air-defence, radar, maritime, mine-laying and communications targets, while Iran struck back at U.S. assets in Jordan, Bahrain and Iraq. The exchange was the most serious escalation in weeks and reconfirms ceasefire_violation; continued Hormuz restrictions reconfirm hormuz_closed. The tracker is already capped at 100/IMMINENT, so no numeric increase is applied.

reports.headline: UN SECURITY COUNCIL SET FOR SEPTEMBER VOTE ON IRAN SANCTIONS MONITORING
reports.text: France said the Security Council is expected to vote on 17 September on renewing the Iran sanctions-monitoring panel; Russia and China oppose the oversight mechanism. This procedural showdown did not cross any configured technical, inspection, treaty, detonation or emergency threshold. Hold Iran nuclear at 75 raw / 82 coupled, IMMINENT.

reports.headline: IAEA access denied at more than 20 Iranian nuclear sites
reports.text: A fresh IAEA quarterly report says Iran is refusing access to more than 20 nuclear sites and that inspectors cannot verify enriched-uranium stocks. Reuters and DPA independently reported the finding. This activates the canonical iaea_access_denied signal; no enrichment-to-90%, nuclear-test, Fordow-activation or NPT-withdrawal threshold was verified.

reports.headline: Two Saudi supertankers struck minutes apart in Strait of Hormuz
reports.text: CBC and Associated Press reporting identifies two Saudi supertankers struck about 12 minutes apart in the Strait of Hormuz. UKMTO incident reporting and the continuing restrictions reconfirm hormuz_closed and ceasefire_violation; the conventional tracker remains capped at 100.

reports.headline: Iran official-warning indicator expires without fresh qualifying confirmation
reports.text: The 29 August Iranian military-command statement has crossed the configured temporal-decay floor. The 16-call deep scan found no fresh qualifying official adoption or technical, inspection, treaty or detonation threshold. The configured official-rhetoric indicator clears and risk falls 73→68 raw / 80→76 coupled, remaining IMMINENT.
sources: AFP via L'Orient Today (29 August source event)

reports.headline: Trump says renewed U.S.-Iran strikes are unlikely to become a major escalation
reports.text: The Washington Post reports that U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States might continue limited military action against Iran but suggested the renewed exchange of strikes was unlikely to become a major escalation. This moderates the latest rhetoric but is not a verified negotiating process and does not change a configured signal. Iran conventional risk holds 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Tanker hit by three projectiles as visible Hormuz traffic falls to five vessels a day
reports.text: Reuters reporting carried by The Business Times says Kpler counted only five visible commodity-vessel transits per day through Hormuz over the weekend. UKMTO said a tanker leaving the strait was struck by three projectiles; no casualties or environmental impact were reported. Brent reached $91.05 and WTI $86.59 at 0044 GMT. The event reconfirms the existing Hormuz closure and kinetic-breach conditions but does not justify a probability increase above the 100 cap.

reports.headline: UN reports nearly 60 civilians killed across Ukraine over the weekend
reports.text: The UN spokesperson said Ukrainian authorities reported nearly 60 civilians killed and 240 injured across the country over the weekend, including 38 killed after a drone strike on an ammunition depot triggered a major explosion in the Kyiv region. The official humanitarian summary corroborates the sustained high-tempo campaign and reconfirms russia_ukraine:military_buildup, but the tracker remains capped at 99/IMMINENT.
sources: United Nations Office of the Spokesperson

reports.headline: UN says escalating Sudan fighting displaced about 22,000 people in Blue Nile
reports.text: The UN spokesperson said local authorities estimated that escalating fighting in Geissan displaced nearly 22,000 people in seven days. The same briefing reported casualties from attacks and drone strikes around El Obeid, a lethal drone strike near the Chad border and renewed displacement from fighting in South Kordofan. This corroborates sustained conflict severity but does not independently establish a new canonical signal beyond Sudan’s already active military_buildup; risk remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.
sources: United Nations Office of the Spokesperson

reports.headline: Man shot dead near Kenya-Somalia border; motive remains unverified
reports.text: Hiiraan Online reports that unidentified attackers killed a man travelling to morning prayers in Lafey Sub-County near the Kenya-Somalia border. Police opened an investigation, but no attacker, motive, al-Shabaab link, infrastructure damage or operational force package was verified. The incident is logged as a watch item; Kenya-Somalia border risk holds 25/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Lebanese speaker warns of existential risk while implementation diplomacy continues
reports.text: Public context unavailable; consult the original source.

reports.headline: Kyiv enters fifth day of near-continuous alerts as Russia expands jet-drone attacks
reports.text: The Kyiv Independent reports a fifth consecutive day of near-continuous alerts in Kyiv as Russia increases jet-powered drone attacks; Ukrainian regional authorities reported at least seven people killed and 45 injured elsewhere over the preceding day. The operational tempo reconfirms military_buildup, but it adds no separate configured transition. Russia-Ukraine risk holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Polish fighters intercept Russian Il-20 over Baltic without airspace breach
reports.text: Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said Polish fighters intercepted a Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft over the Baltic about 30 km from Poland. He said no Polish airspace violation occurred. The encounter is an allied-readiness watch item, not a new configured Russia threshold; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80.

reports.headline: Lebanon speaker rejects buffer zone while U.S.-brokered framework remains active
reports.text: Lebanese Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri rejected a buffer zone or security belt and opposed negotiations under fire. Shafaq reported that seven U.S.-brokered rounds have produced no tangible progress, but the June framework and future negotiating path remain in force. The statement reconfirms diplomacy_refused while diplomacy_active remains active; raw/displayed risk holds 99/100.

reports.headline: Israeli strikes kill at least five Palestinians in Gaza City
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports that two Israeli attacks killed at least five Palestinians in Gaza City, including three people killed when a drone-fired missile struck a vehicle in Tel al-Hawa. The attacks reconfirm ceasefire_violation; Israel-Palestine risk holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Hague panel tells India to honor Indus Waters Treaty pending hydro review
reports.text: The Washington Post and regional reporting say an arbitration panel ordered India to suspend disputed hydroelectric work and comply with the Indus Waters Treaty while review continues. The legal channel is stabilizing but does not establish a configured diplomacy_active threshold; India risk holds 15/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: UAE intercepts Iranian drone and calls the incident a dangerous escalation
reports.text: Associated Press reporting carried by PBS says the UAE intercepted an Iranian drone approaching over its territorial waters and reported no damage. The UAE called the incident a dangerous escalation and a sovereignty violation, while a presidential adviser called for a political solution and normal Hormuz navigation. The incident reconfirms the existing kinetic-breach condition; the political appeal alone is not a verified negotiating process.

reports.headline: Myanmar junta launches heavy Shwegu airstrikes after resistance seizes supply vessel
reports.text: Burma News International and Kachin News Group report repeated airstrikes after KIA/PDF forces damaged and seized a vessel from a 15-ship military supply flotilla. A local estimate of 60–70 bombs in one day was not independently verified. The event reconfirms infrastructure_strike; Myanmar risk holds 35/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Russia reports strategic ICBM launch and missile-force mobility exercise
reports.text: Russia's Defence Ministry said a solid-fuel ICBM launched from Plesetsk reached the Kura test site and that Strategic Missile Forces conducted a mobile-system exercise. The missile type was not identified. The event is a strategic-posture watch item, not an official nuclear-use threat or configured Russia signal; raw/coupled risk holds 70/80.

reports.headline: Thailand confirms late-September BRN peace round focused on safety zones
reports.text: Thai chief peace negotiator Thanut Suvarnananda said a formal round with the same BRN delegation is planned in Malaysia and will focus on reducing violence and possible safety zones. The scheduled facilitated process activates diplomacy_active while the Pattani bombing keeps infrastructure_strike active; risk falls 37→34/CRITICAL.
sources: Thai chief peace negotiator Thanut Suvarnananda

reports.headline: Taiwan says China is tightening air-sea control around the island
reports.text: Reuters reports Taiwan's annual defence review says Beijing is strengthening control of nearby air and sea space and centering exercises on joint blockade/control, while the report says China still lacks the capability for an amphibious assault. No fresh blockade order or attack was verified; raw/coupled risk holds 24/29.

reports.headline: UN nuclear-test session renews disarmament warning without an operational escalation
reports.text: UN News reports that the General Assembly marked the International Day against Nuclear Tests and heard warnings against any resumption of explosive testing. The event is a normative disarmament signal, not evidence of a nuclear test, force movement or new safeguards emergency; no configured tracker changes.

reports.headline: Spain says no evidence Morocco orchestrated the Ceuta migration surge
reports.text: Spanish authorities found no evidence that Morocco directed the Ceuta surge, according to reporting on the prime minister's assessment. The finding weakens external-orchestration claims but does not itself activate a configured diplomatic signal; risk holds 27/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Yemeni forces report seizure of Iranian drone components bound for Houthis
reports.text: Yemen's government-aligned National Resistance Forces said naval units intercepted Iranian-made drone components in the Red Sea en route to the Houthis. Anadolu Agency, Yemen Online and The Arab Weekly carried the claim, but their accounts trace to the same force spokesman; promised footage and component provenance were not independently verified, and Iran and the Houthis did not comment. external_backing remains inactive pending independent material or imagery verification; yemen_red_sea holds 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Russian State Duma deputy explicitly urges tactical nuclear use against Ukraine
reports.text: State Duma deputy and Rodina leader Alexei Zhuravlev said Russia was obliged to use tactical nuclear weapons to force Ukraine to capitulate. His public Telegram channel carried the statement and Kyiv Post documented the quote and role. This clears nuclear_rhetoric_official for the Russia-NATO tracker, but it is not an executive order or evidence of imminent use. Raw/coupled risk rises 70→72 / 80→82.

reports.headline: Civil-society groups warn of escalating Twic-Abyei threats and ultimatum
reports.text: Eye Radio reports two peacebuilding groups warned of hostile propaganda, direct threats and a reported seven-day displacement ultimatum in the Twic-Abyei dispute. They urged presidential and UN intervention. No fresh clash or force mobilization was verified; risk holds 19/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: North Korea vows to strengthen nuclear force amid allied-drill dispute
reports.text: Reuters reports North Korea said U.S. hostility remains unchanged and vowed to strengthen its nuclear force. The rhetoric is escalatory but the tracker has no configured rhetoric signal; no fresh missile_range_test or nuclear_test was verified and risk holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Libyan rival delegations sign UN-sponsored two-year election path
reports.text: Western and eastern Libyan delegations signed a draft final agreement at UNSMIL headquarters covering elections within 24 months, election-commission restructuring and unified institutions. Legislative approval remains unresolved, but the formal implementation step activates diplomacy_active and lowers risk 27→24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Iran fires ballistic missiles at U.S.-used bases in Jordan after Larak strike
reports.text: Iran's IRGC said it fired ballistic missiles at King Hussein and Al-Azraq bases in Jordan after the U.S. strike on Larak Island. Jordan's military said it intercepted eight missiles that entered its airspace, and no casualties were reported. CBC, Deutsche Welle, Task & Purpose and TRT World independently carried the exchange. The response reconfirms the already-active ceasefire_violation signal for iran_conventional; it does not establish a new configured signal, and probability remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Turkish-Somali forces free hijacked MV LUTUF; pirate death toll unverified
reports.text: Somalia's Defence Ministry says a 10-day operation freed the Cameroon-flagged cargo ship, destroyed four pirate boats and killed 14 alleged pirates. AP confirmed the vessel and crew were freed through a local elder, but the death toll and cargo details were not independently verified. Risk holds 38/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Trump threatens Iran's Kharg Island oil hub as U.S.-Iran strikes resume
reports.text: CNBC reports President Trump shared an AI-generated video depicting an attack on Kharg Island, Iran's primary oil-export terminal, and said it was 'going to be blown to smithereens.' This explicit threat activates canonical oil_infrastructure_threat. A separate uncorroborated IRGC tanker-damage claim was excluded from scoring. Iran conventional remains capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: U.S. strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island; IRGC vows retaliation
reports.text: AP and CNN report U.S. forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island after a U.S. official said Iranian forces were preparing rockets carrying sea mines toward Hormuz. Al Jazeera and the IRGC, via IRIB, report casualties and an Iranian retaliation vow. The first U.S. strike in about a month activates ceasefire_violation for iran_conventional; no actual new mine deployment was independently verified. Probability stays capped at 100/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Algeria deploys fighter patrols to support Niger after failed mutiny
reports.text: Algeria's Defence Ministry said two fighter patrols were dispatched on a support mission requested by Niger; official Algerian reporting and independent coverage identify four Su-30 fighters with transport and aerial-refuelling support. The verified foreign military deployment activates external_backing for mali_sahel. Risk rises 40→44/CRITICAL; the event maps to the existing Central Sahel tracker rather than a new zone.

reports.headline: AP confirms 47 killed in Kenscoff gang attack as Haiti holds funerals
reports.text: Associated Press reports hundreds attended funerals after the 23 August Kenscoff attack killed 47 people; the UN Human Rights Office said about 150 heavily armed gang members participated. This is stronger confirmation of the prior event, not a new configured signal transition; haiti_gang_conflict holds 30/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Fresh bombing and demolitions expand across southern Lebanon
reports.text: Lebanon's NNA, Türkiye Today, Arab News and L'Orient Today report a large bombing in Houla plus demolitions of an elderly-care home and other buildings. The activity reconfirms ceasefire violation while diplomacy active remains supported by continuing talks; israel_lebanon holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Nigerian troops repel coordinated Kukawa attack; army says 26 attackers killed
reports.text: The Nigerian Army said troops repelled a coordinated attack on Kukawa in Borno, killing 26 attackers while four soldiers were wounded. Channels Television, Premium Times, TheCable and other outlets carried the statement. No new configured signal is assigned; nigeria_insurgency holds 30/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: U.S. military leaders warn prolonged Iran operations are straining wider readiness
reports.text: The Washington Post reports that several U.S. military leaders advised the defense secretary that extending large-scale Iran operations is unsustainable and would weaken capabilities elsewhere. The Wall Street Journal separately reports that Middle East transfers left some Patriot PAC-3 and ATACMS inventories in Europe beyond critical. This is a material allied-readiness constraint, not a verified withdrawal order or a new configured threshold; probabilities hold.

reports.headline: Iran says Hormuz closed while mediators pursue a conditional shipping route
reports.text: Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said the Strait of Hormuz is closed and vessels seeking passage must coordinate with Iran; Reuters separately described the unresolved conflict as keeping the strait closed. Kpler still counted seven commodity-vessel crossings on Thursday, so this is a general closure with selective passage rather than zero traffic. Oman, Qatar and Pakistan remain engaged in mediation, but no route has been implemented.

reports.headline: Reuters: Israeli strike kills two Palestinians, including a 3-year-old child, in central Gaza
reports.text: Reuters reports that an Israeli airstrike near a bakery in Deir Al-Balah killed two Palestinians, including a three-year-old child, and wounded several others. Gaza health officials supplied the casualty account; the Israeli military said it targeted a Hamas militant without giving further detail. This reconfirms the already-active ceasefire_violation indicator; israel_palestine holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Russia says preparations began for massive strikes on Ukraine's energy system
reports.text: Russia's Defence Ministry said it had begun preparations for massive strikes against Ukraine's energy facilities. POLITICO, NBC News and multiple outlets reported the announcement. The declared operational preparation clears the configured military buildup threshold; russia_ukraine remains capped at 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Yale satellite assessment finds major military buildup at Ethiopia base near Sudan front
reports.text: Yale HRL assessed roughly 100 new light military vehicles, 15 armoured-personnel-carrier-like vehicles and fresh logistics at Ethiopia's Asosa base, warning this could support 750–1,000 personnel and an imminent RSF attack on Ad-Damazin. Eastleigh Voice, Addis Standard and Ahram carried the findings. military_buildup activates; sudan rises 94→100.

reports.headline: Oil ends the week lower as Hormuz-deal rumours circulate
reports.text: A 30 August market wrap reports Friday settlements of Brent at $89.31 and WTI at $83.40, down more than 5% and 4% respectively for the week, while unresolved Hormuz transit disruption remains an upside risk. The report cites market rumours, not a signed shipping agreement; iran_conventional remains 100/IMMINENT with no configured signal change.

reports.headline: Armed insurgents seize Pattani department store and detonate three bombs
reports.text: Bangkok Post and Thai Examiner report five armed insurgents seized Pattani's Global House, evacuated civilians, detonated three bombs and left a nearly 50 kg booby trap for responders. Police and ISOC Region 4 supplied details. This clears the configured infrastructure strike threshold; southern_thailand rises 32→37.

reports.headline: Myanmar military gains ground through airpower, conscription and external pressure
reports.text: Al Jazeera reports that Myanmar's military has retaken 22 of 101 towns lost after the coup, while analysts cite mass conscription, sustained airpower and Chinese pressure on armed groups. The report describes a cumulative strategic shift, not a fresh event inside the configured 72-hour military_buildup window; the tracker holds at 35%.

reports.headline: North Korea replaces defence minister in wider military leadership reshuffle
reports.text: KCNA says Defence Minister No Kwang Chol was dismissed and demoted, Kim Song Gi was appointed, and several other senior officers were promoted. State media also claimed unspecified advances in new combat weapon systems, but no fresh missile launch or nuclear test was reported; the tracker holds at 24%.

reports.headline: Israeli strike hits Gaza hospital compound as other attacks kill four
reports.text: AFP reports that Israel said it targeted a Hamas commander in a storage structure at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, causing four minor injuries and material damage; Gaza civil defence reported four deaths in separate strikes. The event reconfirms the active ceasefire_violation signal without moving the 99% ceiling.

reports.headline: Russia sustains 28-hour combined strike series against Ukraine
reports.text: ISW says Russia launched more than 550 drones and loitering munitions plus an unspecified number of missiles during a strike series lasting over 28 hours on 28–29 August, primarily targeting Kyiv. The campaign reconfirms extreme battlefield escalation but does not create a new configured signal; russia_ukraine remains at 99%.
sources: Institute for the Study of War

reports.headline: Finland's president sees no evidence Russia will risk attacking NATO
reports.text: Reuters and Anadolu report Finnish President Alexander Stubb said he sees no evidence Russia is likely to attack NATO, citing alliance deterrence while warning allies not to lower readiness. No configured signal changes; Russia-NATO holds 70 raw / 80 coupled.

reports.headline: Regional officials meet to strengthen Red Sea and Gulf of Aden maritime security
reports.text: Hiiraan Online reports officials from Somalia, Ethiopia, Yemen and Djibouti met in Nairobi to strengthen maritime law enforcement in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The meeting is a mitigating watch item, but it is not a conflict-party settlement and does not activate a configured signal; somalia_gulf_of_aden holds 38/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Kim Jong Un says North Korea could destroy South Korea if threatened
reports.text: News On AIR reports Kim Jong Un said North Korea could destroy South Korea if its security were threatened. The statement raises rhetorical temperature ahead of the 7-11 September trilateral exercise, but no fresh missile_range_test or nuclear_test was verified; north_korea holds 24/ELEVATED.

reports.headline: Turkish and Somali forces free vessel seized by pirates
reports.text: Somalia’s defence ministry says Turkish and Somali forces freed the hijacked MV LUTUF. The vessel recovery is a mitigating development, but the wider piracy cluster remains active and no configured signal changes; somalia_gulf_of_aden holds 38/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Fresh Gaza attacks reported as ceasefire violations continue
reports.text: TRT World reports fresh Israeli attacks in Gaza under a ceasefire it says remains in effect, including a strike on a delivery-company e-bike whose victim was brought to Al Shifa Hospital. The reporting reconfirms the already-active ceasefire_violation indicator; no implemented settlement or new configured force threshold was verified, so risk holds 99.

reports.headline: Israeli troops raise flag on Lebanese building amid continued southern military activity
reports.text: Middle East Monitor, citing Anadolu reporting and imagery, says Israeli troops raised a flag on a Lebanese-owned building under construction in Kfar Chouba while strikes, shelling and demolitions continued elsewhere in the south. The event reconfirms the existing ceasefire_violation indicator; negotiations remain active and risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Haiti gang releases women and children after mass kidnapping
reports.text: Associated Press reporting syndicated by the Los Angeles Times says six children and seven women were released after a gang kidnapped more than 50 people during the deadly Kenscoff attack. The partial release is mitigating but does not end the attack pattern or activate a configured signal; haiti_gang_conflict holds 30/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Ukraine says Russian planners were tasked to prepare possible Kyiv and Chernihiv offensives
reports.text: POLITICO reports that Ukraine says it has verified intelligence that Russian military chiefs were tasked to plan and prepare possible ground attacks on Kyiv and Chernihiv. The same official said there is not yet evidence of Russian troops gathering for the attacks. This is a serious watch item, but it does not clear the configured military_buildup threshold; Russia–Ukraine risk holds 99.
sources: Office of the President of Ukraine (attributed)

reports.headline: Hezbollah chief rejects Lebanon-Israel framework and demands cancellation
reports.text: Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem publicly rejected the signed framework, called it illegal and demanded its cancellation. A further negotiating round is still expected in September. The explicit refusal activates diplomacy_refused while diplomacy_active and ceasefire_violation remain active; raw risk rises 95→99 and coupling keeps the displayed value at 100.

reports.headline: Iran and Oman discuss a Hormuz traffic plan excluding military vessels
reports.text: Associated Press reports that Iran and Oman are discussing temporary commercial routes through Iranian and Omani waters while excluding military vessels. The proposal reconfirms controlled, non-normal passage and an active diplomatic channel; it does not establish total closure, renewed mining or a fresh force package.

reports.headline: European report rejects claims of a near-term Russian military threat to NATO
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed a Kyiv Post headline saying Europe rejected reports of a Russian military threat to NATO. The article body was not retrievable and no matching NATO release, allied combat step, collective-defence action or nuclear-posture change appeared in reachable official feeds. It is logged as a single-source watch item only; Russia–NATO risk holds.
sources: Kyiv Post via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Saudi delegation concludes Baghdad security talks
reports.text: Google News RSS indexed a New Arab report that a Saudi delegation concluded security talks in Baghdad. No direct article body or official readout was retrievable, so the agenda, implementation and relevance to Iraq’s militia or external-strike risk could not be verified. The item remains a diplomatic watch lead and does not change the Iraq assessment.
sources: The New Arab via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Live index says 82 ships were rerouted under Iran blockade as trade fell
reports.text: Iran International’s live Google News index said U.S. officials reported 82 ships rerouted under Iran’s blockade while Tehran reported a 35% trade decline. The article body and underlying official statements were not retrievable. The headline is consistent with heavily restricted but nonzero Hormuz passage already in the assessment; it does not establish a new closure, mine-laying event, infrastructure strike or force package.
sources: Iran International via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Iranian military-command spokesman explicitly calls for a nuclear deterrent
reports.text: Ebrahim Zolfaghari, spokesman for Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, wrote that Iran needs nuclear weapons to deter Israel. AFP/L'Orient Today and Kurdistan24 carried the statement. It is not a formal doctrine change or evidence of weaponization, but it activates nuclear_rhetoric_official and raises Iran nuclear risk 68→73 raw / 76→80 coupled.

reports.headline: Russian drone strike on warehouse west of Kyiv kills at least 37
reports.text: Associated Press directly reports a Russian drone attack on a warehouse west of Kyiv killed at least 37 people, making it the war's deadliest attack this year. The mass-casualty strike reconfirms severe escalation but does not independently clear a new configured signal; russia_ukraine holds 99/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Lebanese state media reports a new Israeli strike in south Lebanon
reports.text: Lebanon's state-run National News Agency reported that the IDF targeted Nabatieh al-Fouqa on 29 August. The report describes fresh strikes despite the ceasefire and therefore reconfirms the already-active kinetic-breach indicator; it does not justify a duplicate probability increase.
sources: Lebanese National News Agency via Breaking The News

reports.headline: Niger defence ministry says soldiers attempted a mutiny in Niamey
reports.text: DW, Reuters and AFP report that soldiers attacked sensitive sites, targeted the airport/military base and presidential perimeter, and took soldiers hostage. Niger's defence ministry said control was being restored. The event is tracked under mali_sahel but does not yet establish a sustained military_buildup threshold; risk holds 40.

reports.headline: Fresh Gaza and West Bank airstrikes kill eight as the ceasefire remains fragile
reports.text: Associated Press reporting said Israeli strikes killed five people in Gaza and three in Jenin on 28 August. Israel's military confirmed the Gaza strikes but said it was unaware of the Khan Younis strike; it said the Jenin strike targeted a Hamas operative and two accomplices. The report reconfirms the already-active ceasefire_violation indicator without a second probability increment.
sources: Israeli military and Palestinian health officials (attributed)

reports.headline: Suspected Pakistani drones trigger high alert and searches along India’s Line of Control
reports.text: Indian reporting described suspected Pakistani drone activity over the Poonch-Rajouri sector, an army high alert and a search operation. Multiple domestic outlets carried the sightings, but no official attribution, weapons release, casualties or sustained operational force package was established. The item remains a watch signal and does not activate military_buildup.

reports.headline: Niger-overseen prisoner swap and Algerian mediation open a live channel in Mali
reports.text: Al Jazeera, citing AFP and regional security sources, reported that Tuareg rebels freed about 60 Malian soldiers in exchange for FLA figure Inkinane Ag Attaher, with Niger overseeing the exchange and Algeria helping mediate further releases. Fighting continues and Bamako still rules out talks with groups it labels terrorists, but the implemented swap and active mediation clear the configured diplomacy_active threshold. Mali risk falls 43→40.

reports.headline: BBC documents a renewed Somali piracy surge around the Gulf of Aden
reports.text: BBC reporting says at least 13 vessels have been attacked this year and three were hijacked in a recent week. It also reports disputed allegations of Turkish drone strikes near a pirate-held vessel and an unverified concentration of six warships. The piracy trend is material, but no configured threshold is activated pending firmer attribution and operational confirmation.
sources: attributed regional and Turkish official sources

reports.headline: Single-source report claims Iranian missiles targeted Dimona and Arad near Israel’s Negev nuclear complex
reports.text: India’s public broadcaster News On AIR indexed a report that Iran fired missiles toward Dimona and Arad, near the Negev Nuclear Research Center. No independent same-event confirmation, impact assessment, operational detail or official Israeli notice was retrieved in the fallback scan. The claim is logged as a critical watch item only; iran_conventional is already capped at 100 and no canonical signal changes.
sources: News On AIR via Google News RSS

reports.headline: UN and public reporting document fresh Gaza deaths and destroyed aid supplies
reports.text: UN News said Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in Gaza on 28 August; Arab News separately reported five people killed in Gaza strikes. The reports reconfirm the active kinetic breach but do not establish a distinct force package or implemented settlement.

reports.headline: UN Security Council meets as deadly Haiti gang attacks spike
reports.text: UN News reported an emergency Security Council meeting over a deadly spate of gang attacks and illicit-weapons flows. Al Jazeera and NBC reported that the already-documented Kenscoff attack killed 47 and abducted more than 50; this reinforces severity without establishing a separate new attack wave.

reports.headline: Western officials assess Russia seeks to avoid direct NATO war despite harsher rhetoric
reports.text: BBC reporting says Western officials believe Moscow wants to avoid direct military confrontation with NATO, while expecting continued cyber, sabotage and other hybrid activity and warning that miscalculation could still trigger confrontation. No new allied combat step, operational Russian strike order or official nuclear threshold was reported.

reports.headline: Hormuz traffic edges higher but remains below its 10-day average
reports.text: Kpler data reported by The Daily Star counted 10 visible commodity-vessel transits on 27 August, up from eight but below the roughly 15-vessel 10-day average. Iran and Oman were still working on corridor details. This reconfirms restricted but nonzero passage and ongoing diplomacy, not full reopening.

reports.headline: Fresh southern Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah rejection keep truce risk elevated
reports.text: UN reporting and fresh indexed coverage described continuing Israeli strikes in south Lebanon. A later Times of Israel headline said Hezbollah chief Naim Qassem again rejected the proposed Lebanon-Israel deal and refused surrender; without a retrieved formal proposal or cancelled negotiating round, the item is a watch rather than a new diplomacy_refused activation.

reports.headline: Board of Peace envoy warns failures on Gaza roadmap could collapse the ceasefire
reports.text: Nikolay Mladenov told Al Jazeera that failures by both sides to adhere to the roadmap threaten the Gaza ceasefire, while saying advance elements of an international stabilization force should arrive soon. The report also described continued Israeli raids and attacks. It reconfirms the already-active kinetic-breach and diplomatic-process indicators without a separate probability increment.

reports.headline: IAEA chief says Iran retains 440 kg of 60%-enriched uranium as access limits persist
reports.text: Scripps News directly quoted IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi saying Iran retains about 440 kilograms of uranium enriched to 60% and many technical capabilities. Iran's nuclear chief said inspectors still cannot access sites struck during the war until a specific protocol is agreed, while inspections continue at unstruck sites. This reconfirms iaea_access_denied but does not newly establish 90% enrichment, Fordow activation, reprocessing or an explosive weapons trial.

reports.headline: Ceuta unrest escalates to camp fires, police clashes and an attack on a military vehicle
reports.text: BBC reporting said anti-migrant protesters burned belongings and camps, clashed with police and obstructed aid after July's mass crossing. Twelve migrants were arrested over stones thrown at a military vehicle, injuring four occupants. Spain appealed for calm and all parties in Ceuta's assembly condemned the violence. No new military deployment, critical-infrastructure strike or verified foreign support package was established; risk holds 27.

reports.headline: Qatar extends LNG force majeure as Hormuz LNG traffic remains stalled
reports.text: OilPrice, citing market reports, said Qatar extended LNG force majeure through October or early November, Asian spot LNG reached $23.388/MMBtu and European gas rose as LNG transit through Hormuz remained at a standstill even while oil flows partially recovered. This is an energy-stress sanity check and reconfirms restricted, uneven passage; it does not prove zero total traffic or a new kinetic threshold.

reports.headline: Direct reporting confirms a Myanmar monastery airstrike killed 14 civilians
reports.text: AFP-syndicated reporting retrieved from The Daily Star said a 28 August airstrike hit a monastery hall in Myaung township, Sagaing, during a Buddhist Lent meditation retreat, killing 14 people aged roughly 50–70. Two opposition fighters described the aftermath and a second pass; the military did not respond. This reconfirms the already-active infrastructure_strike indicator without duplicate probability uplift.

reports.headline: Russia test-launches a mobile solid-fuel ICBM from Plesetsk
reports.text: Russia's Defence Ministry said the Strategic Missile Forces launched an unspecified mobile solid-fuel ICBM from Plesetsk and hit the Kura range in Kamchatka. Multiple outlets corroborated the event. It is a strategic-posture watch item, but no new official nuclear-use threat or NATO-directed strike order was verified, so no configured signal or probability changes.

reports.headline: CENTCOM says Hormuz transit lanes are mine-free, but commercial traffic remains subdued
reports.text: Al-Monitor quoted CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper saying internationally recognized Hormuz transit routes had been cleared of Iranian sea mines, while reporting that Kpler still counted only five vessel transits on Thursday and that Iran was preparing conditions for full reopening. This supports restricted, nonzero passage and active corridor diplomacy rather than normalized traffic or a fully closed strait.

reports.headline: Vietnam objects to reported Chinese construction in the disputed Paracel Islands
reports.text: U.S. News & World Report and Firstpost indexed reports that Vietnam demanded an end to Chinese construction in the disputed Paracel Islands. The retrieved evidence establishes a diplomatic objection and a construction watch, but article-level details were not available through the fallback feed and no fresh operational force package or kinetic act was verified. South China Sea risk therefore holds.

reports.headline: BBC says Chad put border forces on maximum alert after alleged Sudanese strike
reports.text: BBC reporting said Chad placed forces along the Sudan border on maximum alert after accusing Sudan's army of an airstrike roughly 100 km inside Chad on 20 August. Sudan denied the charge, while a U.S. envoy condemned the alleged cross-border strikes and urged a humanitarian truce. The corroboration sharpens the spillover watch but does not verify a new operational deployment or distinct strike inside this scan window; risk holds 94.

reports.headline: Single energy-news headline says Lebanon and Israel agreed to a ceasefire
reports.text: EnergyNow indexed a headline saying oil fell after Lebanon and Israel agreed to a ceasefire. Article-level retrieval failed and no matching official implementation notice was found on the directly reachable UN or NATO pages. Existing mediation remains active, but this isolated headline is not treated as proof of a new implemented settlement or as grounds for a probability change.

reports.headline: Local reporting says intense Myanmar airstrikes displaced residents around Thandwe
reports.text: Burma News International reported that residents fled intense military airstrikes around Thandwe in Arakan State. The item is consistent with the already-active aerial-attack indicator, but no independent same-event corroboration was retrieved, so the scan does not reset its evidence clock or add a probability increment.
sources: Burma News International via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Reports say a sanctioned tanker was hijacked off Yemen and diverted toward Somalia
reports.text: Hiiraan Online indexed reports that a U.S.-sanctioned tanker was hijacked off Yemen and diverted toward Somalia, amid separate IMO-based reporting of a sharp 2026 piracy increase. The headline is a serious maritime watch item, but no official incident notice or independently retrieved article body established a new configured threshold. Somalia/Gulf of Aden risk holds.
sources: AFP-IMO context via Google News RSS

reports.headline: Shipping report says Hormuz traffic remains subdued despite an apparent reopening
reports.text: OilPrice.com indexed a report that Hormuz shipping remained subdued despite an apparent reopening. This is consistent with the established restricted-but-nonzero passage assessment and with elevated direct energy prices; it does not prove broad normalization or create a new probability increment.

reports.headline: U.S. president claims escorted oil traffic and removal of two suspected mine-laying vessels in Hormuz
reports.text: Anadolu Agency directly reported the U.S. president's claim that oil vessels continue to transit under escort and that U.S. forces removed two vessels involved in attempted mine-laying. The claims support controlled but nonzero passage, but without independent incident details they do not activate hormuz_mining or establish broad commercial reopening.

reports.headline: Oil-price index says Hormuz flows improved; direct feed still shows a large conflict premium
reports.text: EnergyNow.com indexed a report that oil prices eased as Hormuz flows improved while the U.S.–Iran standoff continued. Article-level retrieval was blocked, so the flow claim is not treated as proof of broad reopening. The direct OilPriceAPI feed at 12:02Z showed Brent $89.56 (+1.36%/24h), WTI $83.11, and UK gas 171.00 GBp (+3.62%/24h), consistent with persistent supply anxiety. This reconfirms hormuz_controlled_not_closed without changing a signal or probability.

reports.headline: UKMTO says a tanker was hit by an unidentified projectile in Hormuz
reports.text: UKMTO said a tanker was struck while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on 25 August, causing a fire that was extinguished; all crew were safe. Multiple outlets carried the maritime notice, but the origin of the projectile remained under investigation. The incident strengthens the restricted-passage risk assessment without establishing attribution, renewed mine-laying or a distinct configured signal transition.

reports.headline: Satellite imagery indicates another probable Chinese military-support site in the Paracels
reports.text: Telegraph reporting syndicated by Yahoo, citing Vantor imagery and regional analysts, said structures on Yagong islet resemble radar or early-warning facilities supporting nearby Antelope Reef construction. The long-term posture change is material, but construction alone does not establish an immediate collision, blockade, weapons release or short-window operational buildup. South China Sea risk holds 40.

reports.headline: DR Congo president excludes M23 from national dialogue but retains separate peace framework
reports.text: AFP-carried reporting said President Félix Tshisekedi ruled M23 out of a planned national reconciliation dialogue while naming the Washington agreement as the proper framework for the armed group and leaving a reintegration path open for those renouncing violence. Because an alternate formal process remains, this is not coded as diplomacy_refused and does not change probability.

reports.headline: Direct feed keeps Brent and WTI elevated without a new canonical threshold
reports.text: Direct feed: Brent $88.23 (+2.30%/24h), WTI $83.01 (+1.80%), and UK gas 173.20 GBp (+3.40%). Elevated energy stress remains a sanity indicator; it does not independently verify a canonical kinetic threshold. Hormuz remains restricted but nonzero; probabilities and canonical signals are unchanged.

reports.headline: EU and Western partners urge Pretoria framework implementation as Tigray tensions persist
reports.text: The Eastleigh Voice reported a joint EU, Canada, Norway and UK appeal for constructive implementation of the Pretoria cessation framework and support for renewed AU mediation. Tigray authorities said the latest consultations yielded no concrete proposal but remained open to credible dialogue. The report is a secondary expert review rather than a fresh IAEA finding; it does not establish a new technical production threshold, a detonation, renewed activity at a named facility or an emergency action. Risk holds 61 raw / 68 coupled.

reports.headline: Follow-on outlet repeats Tigray authority appeal as renewed-conflict fears grow
reports.text: The Eastleigh Voice repeated the Tigray regional authority’s call for urgent international intervention, following the earlier Addis Standard report. The second outlet broadens syndication but does not add independent operational detail on a new strike, force movement or verified halt. Existing force_mobilization and renewed_clashes remain controlling; risk holds 44/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Egypt opens a new mediation channel with Iran as sanctions rhetoric hardens
reports.text: WRAL and Asharq Al-Awsat public-news indexes report Egyptian contact with Iran and an effort to revive U.S.–Iran negotiations. The outreach reinforces the existing active mediation context, while Tehran’s rejection of planned U.S. sanctions shows that rhetoric remains hostile. It does not establish a formal negotiating round, a wider Hormuz reopening, a new force package or a newly verified strike. Risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: New deadly Gaza strikes cast doubt on ceasefire progress after Kushner visit
reports.text: The National Herald, Telegraph Herald, Goshen News and Asharq Al-Awsat carried matching reports that new Israeli strikes in Gaza caused deaths and cast doubt on ceasefire progress days after Jared Kushner’s visit. Publicly retrievable indexes did not expose enough incident detail to assign a second score. The reporting reinforces the already-active truce-breach context; risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: Spain sends more than 150 additional soldiers to Ceuta
reports.text: Morocco World News, citing Spain’s Defense Staff and Defense Ministry, reports more than 150 soldiers from the Canary Islands Command are joining Army capabilities already deployed in Ceuta amid the border crisis. The reinforcement activates canonical military_buildup; Spain / Morocco Ceuta rises 22→27 and enters CRITICAL. Spain describes the mission as support to civilian security forces.

reports.headline: Nigeria insurgency clears auto-detection gate after mass killing and abduction reports
reports.text: BBC, DW and AFP-syndicated reporting describe scores killed or abducted during attacks on villages and Friday prayers in Niger State. The cluster clears the configured threshold of at least three mentions from at least two source organizations, so a Nigeria insurgency tracker is added at 30/CRITICAL. No separate configured indicator is assigned.

reports.headline: IDF confirms strike in southwestern Syria against operative it called an immediate threat
reports.text: The Times of Israel reports the IDF confirmed a strike in southwestern Syria against an operative it said posed an immediate threat to troops; Syrian-linked reports say one person was wounded. The event is outside the tracker’s Idlib infrastructure focus and does not establish a qualifying infrastructure impact or distinct new force package. Risk holds 25/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Iran grants selective Hormuz passage to Iraqi oil tankers
reports.text: Multiple public-news indexes citing Iranian state media report that some Iraqi oil tankers received permission to pass through Hormuz. The selective waiver confirms controlled but non-zero traffic and refreshes hormuz_controlled_not_closed; it does not establish general reopening, closure, mining or zero traffic. Risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Former British and French diplomats urge action over Palestinian territorial erosion
reports.text: The Guardian reports that former British and French diplomats urged stronger action over what they described as the erasure of Palestine; GCC and other regional governments separately reiterated opposition to E1 settlement expansion. The pressure is diplomatically significant but does not establish a durable mediation breakthrough or a new configured kinetic threshold. Risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: U.S. envoy warns Israeli Syria strike risked confrontation with Türkiye
reports.text: Bloomberg, Haaretz and Türkiye Today report that a U.S. envoy warned the earlier Israeli strike on a Syrian air base near the Turkish border risked baiting Ankara into confrontation. The warning elevates the political watch but does not verify a new Turkish deployment or distinct additional force package. Syria / Idlib risk holds 25/CRITICAL; Turkey holds 5/DETERRENT.

reports.headline: Houthis claim a third missile attack on Israel
reports.text: News On AIR reports Yemen’s Houthi movement claimed responsibility for a third missile attack on Israel. No independent impact confirmation, casualty report or distinct force deployment was retrieved in this scan. The claim is logged as a verification watch item and does not activate a new canonical signal; risk holds 95/IMMINENT.

reports.headline: UNAMA confirms civilian deaths and injuries from Pakistani airstrikes in Kabul
reports.text: News On AIR reports that the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan confirmed deaths and injuries from Pakistani airstrikes in Kabul. This upgrades the underlying incident from party claim to UN-attributed corroboration, but the tracker has no configured airstrike indicator and the review found no separate new force deployment. Risk holds 43/CRITICAL.
sources: United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA)

reports.headline: Tigray regional authority seeks urgent diplomacy amid reported escalating attacks
reports.text: Addis Standard indexed a Tigray regional-authority appeal for urgent diplomatic intervention amid escalating attacks. The underlying page was Cloudflare-blocked and no independent operational detail was retrieved. The report is consistent with the existing clash and mobilization context but is not sufficient to activate another configured indicator or raise risk; Ethiopia / Tigray holds 44/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Reports of phosphorus shelling add to southern Lebanon ceasefire-breach context
reports.text: Anadolu and Shafaq carried Lebanese-media reports of phosphorus shelling in southern Lebanon, while JFeed reported an IDF strike near Nabatieh. The reporting reinforces the already-active ceasefire_violation context but is not sufficient to activate a distinct new configured signal. Risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: UKMTO-attributed report puts Hormuz commercial traffic at 20% of pre-war levels
reports.text: A public-news report citing UK Maritime Trade Operations says commercial traffic through Hormuz is about 20% of pre-war levels; a separate report quotes the U.S. energy secretary saying the U.S. Navy moved 15 million barrels through in one day. The evidence confirms severely degraded but non-zero passage, refreshing hormuz_controlled_not_closed without establishing closure, mining or zero traffic. Risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Trump calls Hormuz “American territory” as Iran maintains hostile rhetoric
reports.text: Trump called Hormuz ‘American territory’ while Iran answered with hostile rhetoric; Oman and Iran also continued talks on shipping safeguards. The language is escalatory but does not establish closure, mining, zero traffic, a fresh force package or an oil-infrastructure strike. Existing ceasefire_violation, diplomacy_active and hormuz_controlled_not_closed remain controlling; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: India condemns reported Pakistani airstrike on Kabul treatment hospital
reports.text: India publicly condemned a reported Pakistani airstrike on an addiction-treatment hospital in Kabul. The fallback scan retrieved the Indian statement but not independent operational confirmation; the tracker has no configured cross-border-strike signal and no distinct force buildup was verified. Risk holds 43/CRITICAL.

reports.headline: Myanmar clears auto-detection gate after monastery bombing and separate military offensive report
reports.text: Myanmar cleared the configured auto-detection gate after AP/Al Jazeera reported a fighter-jet bombing of a Buddhist monastery that killed 14 and Reuters separately documented a military offensive tied to land for a Russia-backed port project; multiple additional public-news indexes carried the events. The tracker enters conservatively at 30/CRITICAL. No configured signal is activated because the evidence does not establish a new force deployment, qualifying infrastructure strike, fresh external weapons commitment or diplomatic threshold.

reports.headline: Pentagon tally puts U.S. personnel wounded in the Iran war above 750
reports.text: The Washington Post, The Hill and other follow-on reporting cite Pentagon figures showing more than 750 U.S. service members wounded during the Iran war. The cumulative toll underscores the conflict’s cost but does not establish a new strike, deployment, Hormuz closure, mining event or zero-traffic condition. Iran conventional risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Iran threatens a broad response as NATO commander coordinates allied Hormuz discussion
reports.text: Reuters, carried in full by Al-Monitor, reports Iran’s armed-forces chief threatened a broad response to new U.S. pressure. The same report says NATO’s top commander convened allied defence chiefs to discuss support for freedom of navigation in Hormuz; a spokesperson stressed this is not a NATO mission. Iran-Oman navigation contacts continue, and Reuters/Kpler still show restricted but non-zero passage. No new deployment or closure threshold is established; risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled.

reports.headline: Fresh reporting says Somali piracy incidents are rising as naval forces remain stretched
